topic: The Riemann Zeta Function: Bridging Primes and Patterns

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Power Series Foundation
lecture_lines: Consider an infinite sum of powers.
As s increases, terms shrink rapidly.
This allows the series to converge.

sections.title: Defining the Riemann Zeta Function
lecture_lines: The Riemann Zeta function sums integers.
It extends into the complex plane.
This is known as analytic continuation.
The domain covers the whole plane.

Show the sum 1/n^s converging for Re(s) > 1. Color: '#2ECC71'.
